news.analysis: As expected, Stafford's elbow injury is nothing serious at this point and won't prevent him from playing on Sunday. He should be good to go, although he is harder to trust starting on a week-to-week basis now with several key pass catchers sidelined due to injury for the Rams.

Williams has been great for most of the season, but underwhelmed in a tougher matchup. To make matters worse, backfield mate Blake Corum got into the end zone for a third straight game and was again more efficient with his touches. news.analysis: McCaffrey was able to dominate in another big role for the 49ers. He remains an RB1 heading into next week against the Cowboys.

McCaffrey also hauled in two of his three targets for 19 yards and an additional score through the air. When McCaffrey is healthy, he's one of the best players in the league. news.analysis: With Jeremiyah Love on IR and Bam Knight in concussion protocol, Allgeier took over the workhorse role in the Cardinals backfield. He was the only running back to see a carry for Arizona. From a volume standpoint, he'll be an RB2 play next week against the Rams if Knight remains sidelined.

He also caught two of his three targets, but they resulted in net zero receiving yards. Allgeier operated as the Cardinals' No. 1 running back with Jeremiyah Love (ankle) and Bam Knight (concussion) inactive. news.analysis: Higgins did not see a ton of targets Sunday, but made the most of his opportunities by hauling in two touchdowns. Higgins has found the end zone in three straight games, including back-to-back multi-touchdown performances. Higgins and the Bengals will look to continue that momentum against the Steelers in Week 10.

news.title: Tee Higgins hits pay dirt twice in Week 9 win

Joe Burrow found him from four yards out in the second quarter, then went back to him from eight yards out after the Atlanta Falcons pulled within seven. Higgins finished with five catches on six targets for 32 yards and 20.2 PPR points in Cincinnati's 34-17 Week 9 win. news.analysis: Nacua will undergo an MRI Monday to determine the severity of the injury, although the team believes the wideout avoided an ACL injury in Sunday's win. Nacua hauled in 14 of his team-leading 19 targets for 150 yards and one touchdown while also rushing twice for 20 yards prior to suffering the injury.

news.title: Puka Nacua suffers knee injury Sunday

news.contents: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua (knee) will undergo an MRI on Monday after getting hurt on a five-yard run with 1:44 left in Sunday's 20-13 win over the Washington Commanders. Mike Garafolo and Adam Schefter reported that the injury occurred on the Rams' final offensive snap and that the team's initial belief is that Nacua avoided an ACL tear. After questions to begin the year, Bass has come through with an incredible start to the year and is RotoBaller's eighth-ranked kicker this week.
